title: Project supported legacy mix-table events into GP8 automation
scope: Translate supported beat-local instrument, tempo, volume and balance changes into equivalent target events; classify other controllers individually.
acceptance: Use a legacy beat with simultaneous tempo, program, volume and balance changes at a nonzero position.
Preserve timing and event order while avoiding duplicates with score/track automation collections.
For chorus, reverb, phaser, tremolo and transitions, implement a verified wire mapping or retain an exact per-controller omission.
exclusions: Do not synthesize audio or implement proprietary RSE processing.

reproduction.instructions: Use a legacy beat with simultaneous tempo, program, volume and balance changes at a nonzero position.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.

Raw consumer/MIDI proves program73 tick960 -> tick0 despite exact GPIF/Go position0.25; fixture testdata/gp3/mix-table-events.gp3 derives from original other-effects.gp3 by inserting a complete GP3 mix-table record.

resolution: Implemented authored-value projection of legacy tempo/program/volume/balance events with explicit collection edit/clear authority, duplicate avoidance, order and ownership, plus individual controller/transition/RSE losses. A complete GP3 simultaneous event at beat1 position0.25 has exact GPIF/Go values. Residual acceptance blocker: pinned GPIF moves program73 from source MIDI tick960 to target tick0; gain and pan are ignored by that consumer under established per-event policies. The full consumer-timing criterion is not satisfied at the pin. Keep this ticket open/in_progress pending fresh exact-commit review and parent integrated full gates/probe; do not claim full preservation.
verification: Public complete-GP3 regression fails on pre-change production through a Go overlay and passes with the implementation.
Focused public and matrix tests cover collision policy subsets, clearing, equal-position order, all-tracks expansion, fractional timing, bank retention, bounds and individual losses.
Independent pinned raw source/output beat facts and generated MIDI ticks prove exact retained and normalized distinctions.
Full conformance/check.sh, capability probe and prek belong to parent integration; independent exact-commit review pending.
